name: Prashant Kumar Yadav
headline: Software developer building voice AI and the Go services that keep it on the line.
summary: Prashant is a final-year B.Tech student in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence at IIIT Lucknow (2023 to 2027, GPA 8.6).

He has interned at Walmart Global Tech, Nugget by Zomato, Eternal (Zomato), and UBIQCURE, working on voice AI, Go microservices, telephony, data pipelines, AI observability agents, and cloud infrastructure.
He is a regular contributor to stdlib-js, the standard library for JavaScript, with more than 145 merged pull requests.
He likes shipping ambitious systems, instant coffee, and anime.

Kubernetes, Helm, GitOps CI/CD with GitHub Actions and ArgoCD on AWS and Azure
Retrieval-augmented generation, LLM agents, and Model Context Protocol tooling
Full-stack web products with React, Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL

faq.q: Is Prashant open to internships or full-time roles?
faq.a: Prashant graduates from IIIT Lucknow in June 2027 and is interested in software engineering internships and full-time roles, especially in backend systems, infrastructure, and applied AI. The fastest way to reach him is the contact page or email at devprashantkyadav@gmail.com.
Prashant is based in India. He studies at IIIT Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, and has worked both onsite and remotely during his internships.

faq.q: What kind of work does Prashant enjoy most?
faq.a: He gravitates toward complex, high-performance systems: voice AI pipelines, Go microservices, telephony, Kubernetes platforms, and retrieval-augmented generation. Recent internships at Zomato and Walmart were in exactly these areas.
Use the contact form on the site, email devprashantkyadav@gmail.com, or connect on LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/prashantyadav097) and GitHub (github.com/0PrashantYadav0). His resume is at /resume.pdf.
Yes. He is a Codeforces Specialist with a peak rating of 1534 and a 4-star coder on CodeChef with a peak rating of 1813, and he placed 386th globally in a Codeforces Division 2 contest.
